    best = float('inf')
    for start in range(n):
        # BFS
        parent = [-1]*n
        dist = [-1]*n
        queue = [start]
        dist[start] = 0
        for u in queue:
            for v in adj[u]:
                if dist[v] == -1:
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + 1
                    parent[v] = u
                    queue.append(v)
                elif v != parent[u]:
                    # found cycle
                    cycle_len = dist[u] + dist[v] + 1
                    if cycle_len < best:
                        best = cycle_len
    return best
